thread:
sam_cs: Hi team — Kestrel (enterprise onboarding) returned a 15-page privacy/vendor-assessment this morning. They flagged retention, PII redaction for embeddings, and asked for SOC2 evidence + a short FAQ they can share with their legal squad. Need answers by Fri EOD, leaning on this being a renewal risk if unresolved.

maria_security: I can draft canned responses. We have a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF and a short privacy FAQ already. Want me to attach both? :white_check_mark:

ashley_se: Quick clarifications on retention/embeddings — on the Console we expose per-project retention under Settings > Data Retention. Default is 30 days, can set to 0 (disable retention) for dedicated/private customers. API param example: `{"retention_days":30}`.

sam_cs: Nice. Customer specifically asked: can we purge previously generated embeddings on request, and does that affect billing/usage?

maria_security: Yes — we can purge embeddings and associated cache/indices on request. Purge is irreversible; billing isn't retroactively adjusted (they were charged for storage/compute at generation time). I can write a short blurb: "embeddings can be deleted on request; deletion request triggers background purge and audit log entry."

ashley_se: For engineering: deletion triggers jobs that drop objects from S3 + invalidates local caches. ETA for full purge depends on index size but usually < 24 hours. We log the purge in audit (see /console/audit) and can provide the audit export.

sam_cs: Good — can we include the audit export step in the canned FAQ. Also they asked for encryption details at rest and in transit.

maria_security: Short answer: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private via KMS integration. I'll add a pointer to the security whitepaper and make the FAQ snappy.

dana_pe: FYI — if they ask about model traces/inputs stored for quality monitoring: we only retain request logs for the configured retention window; customers can opt out of logging for sensitive routes. That should be called out.

sam_cs: Perfect. I have to send this back with attachments and the FAQ. Maria — can you assemble today? I'll send the customer a single ZIP with: redacted SOC2, privacy FAQ, short engineering note on purge + audit export, and the retention instructions.

maria_security: On it. I'll post the draft here for review by 4pm PT.

onboarding-bot: Checklist update: "Kestrel onboarding: compliance docs attached" set to In progress by sam_cs at 2140003210.

ashley_se: Quick review note for the draft: include the exact Console path and a screenshot for retention toggle, and add the sample API call to purge: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/PROJECT_ID/purge -d '{"type":"embeddings"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'```

sam_cs: Thanks — that cURL snippet is great. If draft is ready before 4pm I'll do a quick legal check with @legal. We should also mark this as medium renewal risk until signed off.

maria_security: Draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s3/drafts/kestrel-compliance-faq-v1.pdf (internal). Please review and comment inline.

sam_cs: Reviewing now. Will ping legal after I add a short cover note.

ashley_se: If legal asks for the SOC2 issuance date: it's 2024-11-15 and the auditor name is Norton & Gale (redacted copy will show auditor).

sam_cs: Great — closing loop after legal review. Thanks team! :pray:
